module: SUSE Linux Enterprise Server GnuTLS Cryptographic Module
caveat: When operated in FIPS mode. The module generates cryptographic keys whose strengths are modified by available entropy
description: GnuTLS is a secure communications library implementing the TLS protocol. It provides a simple C language application programming interface to access the secure communications protocols as well as APIs to parse and write X.509, PKCS#12, and other required structures which is shipped with SUSE Linux Enterprise Server.
